The GSE engine gates form a layered logical architecture that validates incoming signals through five distinct filters: Live Roster, Provenance & Freshness, JEV Mandatory, Real LCB, and Stamp. Each gate operates under a fail-closed policy, meaning any violation results in immediate rejection rather than approximation. The Live Roster Gate ensures player data consistency between ESPN and Sleeper feeds, rejecting stale or missing entries. The Provenance & Freshness Gate checks for valid timestamps and traceability of data sources. The JEV Mandatory Gate requires that all candidate signals align across multiple independent data streams. The Real LCB Gate applies lower confidence bounds derived from statistical models to filter out unreliable predictions. Finally, the Stamp Gate enforces immutable provenance stamps on each validated signal. These gates collectively prevent erroneous or outdated information from entering the prediction pipeline, maintaining system integrity and model reliability.
